blocks.title: Catalyst
blocks.text: Catalyst woh cheez (substance) hai jo chemical reaction ki rate badal deti hai, lekin reaction ke aakhir mein khud chemically waisi ki waisi rehti hai.

Catalyst aksar bohat thori miqdar mein hota hai. Maslan H₂ aur O₂ se pani banne ki reaction aam temperature par bohat sust hai, lekin platinum ki maujoodgi mein tez chalti hai; yahan platinum catalyst hai. Isi tarah thore se MnO₂ ke saath KClO₃ bohat tezi se toot-ta hai. CuCl₂ ki maujoodgi mein HCl oxidize ho kar Cl₂ banta hai.

Catalyst ki maujoodgi mein hone wale amal ko catalysis kehte hain. Catalyst reaction ko ek naya rasta deta hai jis ki activation energy ki rukawat (barrier) kam hoti hai (Figure 7.8). Ab zyada molecules yeh nichi rukawat paar kar lete hain aur reaction ki rate barh jati hai.

blocks.alt: Energy banam progress of reaction. Baen Reactants ka level aur daen neecha Products ka level. Ek ooncha neela ubhar (baghair catalyst) aur ek neecha surkh ubhar (catalyst ke saath) dono levels ko jorte hain. Reactant level se do-sire teer 'Activation Energy without catalyst' (neela, neele ubhar ki choti tak) aur 'Activation Energy with catalyst' (surkh, surkh ubhar ki choti tak) dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.8: Baghair catalyst aur catalyst wali reaction ka energy raasta (kitab ki Figure 7.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 7.8 ke labels mein 'Activaton' chhapa hai; sahi spelling 'Activation' hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neela ubhar baghair catalyst wala rasta hai aur surkh nicha ubhar catalyst wala. Reactants aur products ki satah (level) dono mein wahi hai; sirf pahari ki unchai, yani activation energy, catalyst se kam hoti hai.
Is mein catalyst aur reactants ek hi phase (halat: gas, liquid ya solid) mein hote hain aur poora system ek jaisa hota hai. Catalyst poore system mein barabar phaila hota hai.
i. Sulphuric acid banane ke contact process mein SO₂(g) aur O₂(g) se SO₃(g) banane ke liye NO(g) catalyst hai. Reactants aur catalyst sab gases hain.
ii. Esters H₂SO₄ ki maujoodgi mein hydrolyze hote hain (pani se toot-te hain). Reactants aur catalyst sab solution mein hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Jaandaron (living organisms) ke biochemical catalysts ko enzymes (qudrat ke catalysts) kehte hain. Yeh activation energy kam kar ke reactions tez karte hain. Enzymes aam taur par proteins hote hain. pH, temperature aur substrate molecules ki concentration enzyme ke kaam par asar karte hain.
Is mein catalyst aur reactants alag alag phases mein hote hain. Zyada tar catalyst solid hota hai aur reactants gas ya liquid. Misalein:
Platinum gauze (jaali) ki maujoodgi mein ammonia oxidize ho kar NO banti hai; is se HNO₃ banaya jata hai.
Unsaturated organic compounds ki hydrogenation (hydrogen milana) bareek pise hue Ni, Pd ya Pt se catalyse hoti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Vitamins organic compounds hain jo biochemical reactions mein catalyst ka kaam karte hain, khaas taur par coenzymes ke taur par. Coenzymes woh organic molecules hain jo enzymes ko behtar kaam karne mein madad dete hain. Maslan vitamin K khoon jamne ke liye zaroori hai; is ki kami se khoon behne ki bimari (bleeding diathesis) ho sakti hai. Vitamins ki kami cofactor ki kami ki ek misal hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Kya catalyst chemical reaction mein kharch ho sakta hai? Kyun ya kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Catalyst ki pehchan hi yeh hai ke reaction ke aakhir mein woh chemically waisa hi rehta hai. Woh darmiyani qadmon mein hissa le sakta hai, lekin aakhir mein dobara ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: b) 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2SO₃(g) (NO(g) catalyst ke saath) heterogeneous catalysis hai ya homogeneous?
blocks.explanation: Homogeneous, kyun ke reactants (SO₂, O₂) aur catalyst (NO) sab gas phase mein hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Baghair catalyst aur enzyme-catalysed reaction ka energy profile diagram banayein aur dono ki activation energy dikhayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono curves reactants ki ek hi satah se shuru ho kar products ki ek hi satah par khatam hote hain. Baghair catalyst wala ubhar ooncha hai (zyada activation energy); enzyme wala ubhar kahin neecha hai (kam activation energy). Activation energy ko reactants ki satah se har ubhar ki choti tak teer se dikhayein.

answer_figure.alt: Energy profile, energy banam progress of reaction. Reactants aur products ki lines dono curves ke liye ek hi hain. Neela curve (baghair catalyst) ki choti oonchi hai, surkh curve (enzyme ke saath) ki choti neechi. Reactants ki satah se har choti tak teer: neela 'Ea without catalyst' bara, surkh 'Ea with enzyme' chhota.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: baghair catalyst aur enzyme-catalysed reaction ka energy profile, dono activation energies ke saath
answer_figure.long_description: Dono raste ek hi reactants se shuru ho kar ek hi products par khatam hote hain, is liye ΔH nahin badalta. Enzyme ek naya raasta deta hai jis ki pahari (energy barrier) kahin neechi hai. Neela teer baghair catalyst ki activation energy hai aur surkh teer enzyme ke saath wali; surkh teer chhota hai, is liye zyada molecules barrier paar kar lete hain aur reaction tez hota hai.

items: Catalyst rate badalta hai aur aakhir mein waisa hi rehta hai; yeh kam Eₐ wala naya rasta deta hai.

Homogeneous: ek hi phase (contact process mein NO, ester hydrolysis mein H₂SO₄); heterogeneous: alag phases (NH₃ oxidation mein Pt gauze, hydrogenation mein Ni). Enzymes aur vitamins (coenzymes) jaandaron ke catalysts hain.
